# Explicit CA catalog SKU list (one sku per line).
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (D-10): the CLI loads this committed list as the catalog so a
# catalog SKU that is ABSENT from the premium export surfaces as "no data (not in
# premium export)" at runtime — never 0/blank, and never a silent export-rows fallback
# that would make the not-in-export path unreachable.
#
# REAL SEED (plan 02-03): re-seeded from the first live DataDoe pull
# (Profit by SKU & Date 57a0cb319c, marketplace CA, trailing 30d, 2026-06-09).
# These are the SKUs DataDoe returned for the window. The seller UUID is NEVER
# written here; SKU codes and policy numbers are not secrets.
#
# NOTE: this is the export-observed set (22 SKUs). If the operator's full known CA
# catalog is larger (~30), add the missing SKUs here so they surface as "no data
# (not in premium export)" rather than being invisible. Until then, a known SKU that
# never appears in any export will not be flagged — that gap closes when the full
# catalog (or sku_master, Phase 3.5) is the source.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored by the loader.
